# ThriftBooks



At ThriftBooks, we believe reading should be accessible to everyone. Since 2003, we’ve been giving books a second life by offering millions of used and new titles at prices that make reading more affordable. From bestsellers and classics to rare finds and textbooks, our website and mobile app make it easy to discover your next cheap read. We’re proud to offer free shipping options, a rewards program through ReadingRewards, and to support literacy and sustainability initiatives. Our mission is simple: to spread the love of reading while reducing waste—one book at a time.



# Home Page



- [New & Used Books | Buy cheap Books Online at ThriftBooks](https://www.ThriftBooks.com/): Over 13 million titles available from the largest seller of used books. cheap prices on high quality gently used books. Free shipping over $15.

    var isMobileApp = document.cookie
    .split("; ")
    .some(function (c) {
        var parts = c.split("=");
        return parts[0] === "tba" && parts[1] === "1";
    });
    if(!isMobileApp) return;

    var validPage = window.location.pathname !== "/" && window.location.pathname !== "/checkout/orderfinal/"
    if(!validPage) return;

    var btn = document.getElementById("tbBackButton");
    if (!btn) return;

    var isThriftbooksReferrer = document.referrer &&
        (document.referrer.indexOf("thriftbooks.com") !== -1 ||
        document.referrer.indexOf("localhost:12399") !== -1);

    if (isThriftbooksReferrer) {
        btn.style.display = "block";
        document.querySelectorAll(
            ".CheckoutHeaderLogoLinkLarge, .CheckoutHeaderLogoLinkSmall"
        ).forEach(el => el.classList.add("appLogo"));
    }

    /**this is a window variable we've defined in the android app because it doesn't send a referrer**/
    window._tbSetCanGoBack = function (canGoBack) {
        if (!canGoBack) return;

        btn.style.display = "block";

        document.querySelectorAll(
            ".CheckoutHeaderLogoLinkLarge, .CheckoutHeaderLogoLinkSmall"
        ).forEach(function (el) {
            el.classList.add("appLogo");
        });
    };

})();

    var isMobileApp = document.cookie
    .split("; ")
    .some(function (c) {
        var parts = c.split("=");
        return parts[0] === "tba" && parts[1] === "1";
    });
    if(!isMobileApp) return;

    var validPage = window.location.pathname !== "/" && window.location.pathname !== "/checkout/orderfinal/"
    if(!validPage) return;

    var btn = document.getElementById("tbBackButton");
    if (!btn) return;

    var isThriftbooksReferrer = document.referrer &&
        (document.referrer.indexOf("thriftbooks.com") !== -1 ||
        document.referrer.indexOf("localhost:12399") !== -1);

    if (isThriftbooksReferrer) {
        btn.style.display = "block";
        document.querySelectorAll(
            ".CheckoutHeaderLogoLinkLarge, .CheckoutHeaderLogoLinkSmall"
        ).forEach(el => el.classList.add("appLogo"));
    }

    /**this is a window variable we've defined in the android app because it doesn't send a referrer**/
    window._tbSetCanGoBack = function (canGoBack) {
        if (!canGoBack) return;

        btn.style.display = "block";

        document.querySelectorAll(
            ".CheckoutHeaderLogoLinkLarge, .CheckoutHeaderLogoLinkSmall"
        ).forEach(function (el) {
            el.classList.add("appLogo");
        });
    };

})();
